about: East of the River Lum, between the castle bridge and the cow field: the goblins of Lozar's ruined house and the land around it (goblin_unarmed_melee_1 to 8, ids 3029 to 3036, all level 2), the level 2 giant spiders among them, and Barfy Bill at the canoe station. Tiles and types are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, checked against the 241 map (one goblin tile was water and moved a tile east). Every wander range is guessed (5, Barfy Bill 2) until recorded. The giant spiders are aggressive on live; NPC aggression comes with the Varrock piece, so until then they fight back only. The church's NPCs are their own step; the canoes, Barfy Bill's Store-axe and the fishing spots are left out (canoeing, and the gathering skills).
